title: Global Military Spending Reached a New High in 2025
discussion_signal: SIPRI reports regional military-spending increases in Europe and Asia-Pacific while the Americas declined, with the discussion linking the figures to NATO, security, peace, and the transparency of new spending targets.
linked_research_question: How does military spending convert into state and alliance capacity, and what remains uncertain when accounting boundaries and capability quality vary?
limits: Spending is an input measure, not a direct measure of capability or political outcome
The post does not resolve accounting comparability across states
